metadata.title: Massive star cluster formation II. Runaway stars as fossils of sub-cluster mergers

notes: No eligible stars. The paper's simulated "runaway stars" are selected only by E_total > 0 relative to the model cluster (T:p3-b8), not by a Milky-Way escape criterion. Groups 1 and 2 are simulated populations without individual stellar identifiers (T:p3-b9, T:p4-b1). The observed R136, NGC 6618, NGC 360, and Westerlund 2 examples are cluster-ejected runaway populations with no Galactic-unbound determination (T:p6-b2, T:p7-b1, T:p7-b3). HD 14633 and HD 15137 are described as confirmed runaway O-star binaries with unknown ejection mechanism, not as Galactic-unbound stars (T:p8-b8). The HVS/SCES-BSS discussion is a generic channel, not an identified Galactic-unbound star (T:p9-b3, T:p9-b6).
